# MCU Viewing Order

> A focused viewing-order guide for Marvel, DC, X-Men, and Sony superhero films and series.

## Main experience
- https://mcu-viewing-order.vercel.app/
- https://mcu-viewing-order.vercel.app/#list
- https://mcu-viewing-order.vercel.app/#analytics

## Summary
MCU Viewing Order helps people discover a coherent story sequence, track watched titles, save favorites, and explore related timelines. Content is presented as a practical guide and is not affiliated with Marvel Studios, DC Studios, Sony Pictures, or Disney.
